notes.title: CHEATER UPDATE is here!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24311777/d33c67e7d76fc2af638f4fcd14981c86b6ea5780.png[/img]

How many times have you lost to TrafficKing? How many times were you running too low on energy to escape death? How many times have you missed a gun and never unlocked it until the end?... 

Lament no more! RUINER: Cheater Update lets you sit back and enjoy all of the game’s flavours to the fullest. Use [F8] to preview cheats and press the corresponding key to gain the upper hand.    

[list]
[*][b]God mode[/b] - [1] - become immortal. Not recommended by the Church of Disorder.
[*][b]Conserve energy[/b] - [2] - stop worrying about the skills’ cost. Instantly renew 100% of energy.
[*][b]Add Karma[/b] - [3] - Puppy’s unparalleled strength and quick reflexes now boosted to the max. Gain 25 cores and many points of Karma to instantly unlock all skills.
[*][b]Unlock all guns[/b] - [4] - enter the carnage festival overpowered, guns blazing. [*]Unlock all weapons in the Supply Drop's radial menu.
[*][b]Unlimited ammo[/b] - [5] - recycling guns is a hassle. HEAVEN Corp. decided to drop the costly Grinder project and instead put all its resources in UAT (Unlimited Ammo Tech). What a time to be alive!
[*][b]Unlimited melee durability[/b] - [6] - let’s be honest: recycling melee weapons is a hassle. Now slice your opponents - not a scratch on your shiny sword.
[*][b]Explosive melee kills[/b] - [7] - Puppy’s a cool guy and he enjoys explosions. A lot. Kill enemies to make them go boom!
[*][b]Ghostbreak them all[/b] - [8] - you thought three was a crowd? Hack’em all. Make’em all your friends.
[*][b]Unlimited Dash[/b] - [9] - Dash like crazy ‘cause charges are not used up.
[*][b]Spawn a Creep[/b] - [Insert] - no need to venture alone. Your little loyal Creep friends are there to serve you.
[*][b]Unlock all clothes[/b] - [Home] - make a fashion statement. Blend in or stand out. 
[/list]

All critical resources at your disposal. Slash mercilessly through enemies to your heart’s desire. No limitations. No rules. No regrets. No future.*

[u][i]* Beware or be aware! Once you go hack, there’s no way back. Most of the achievements will be locked if even one tiny cheat is used. Also, cheats will be reset when you close the game.[/i][/u]

[list]
[*][b]Belarusian language added![/b]
[/list]

That’s right. HER has improved Puppy’s communication modules by uploading Belarusian localisation files.

Now go and get’em, puppy!

tags.feature: [b]Belarusian language added![/b]

notes.title: 2nd language update is live now!
notes.content:
[b]Ciao! Merhaba! The second language update for RUINER has just arrived![/b]

This time it’s the long-awaited [b]Italian and Turkish[/b]. Both localisations are complete and polished, locked and loaded.

In the name of the whole [b]Ruiner Team[/b] and the [b]Turkish and Italian[/b] players, hats off and [b]BIG THANKS[/b] to the translators, who did the work in their free time, out of sheer goodness of Their Hearts and the love for [b]Ruiner[/b].

Standing ovation goes to:

[b]The Turkish group[/b]: 
[list][*]AiBell Game Localization[/list]

[b]The Italian group[/b]:
[*]Alessio Patroncini
[*]Claudio Lenato
[*]Jacopo Cremonesi
[*]Marco Mottura
[*]Riccardo Di Giovanni
[*]Simona Giusti[/list]

[b]Thanks again, Puppies <3[/b]. It wouldn’t have happened without you. You’ve just made history!
[i]Sizi seviyoruz, Türk Yavrucaklar! 
Stateci bene, Cucciolotti Italiani![/i]


[h1]Wait, there’s more?[/h1] 

Of course! 
We updated our credits with the new translators, duh.
Puppy’s back on the men… I mean, back in the menu. Main menu. (Those of you who experienced the blackness will know what I mean.)
Plus, for the [b]Linux version[/b]: 
all the cutscenes will now trigger correctly,
bugs that caused sound problems in cutscenes are a thing of the past,
and also, [b]Credits[/b] can now be accessed from the menu.


We hope we’ve made you a tiny bit happier today. 
Let us know if we have.

[i]Now play dead!
That’s a good boy.[/i]

notes.title: The final version of RUINER for Linux is here! *[EDIT]*
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24311777/fb1c3d0441a5e70188b41547e3ae57e878117d0c.png[/img]
[b]Hello Penguins and Puppies,[/b]

[b]Tux Update[/b] is now complete and official. No need to switch to the Linux beta anymore! - get it directly from the default branch. 

Your invaluable support and feedback helped us: 

[list][*]fix the crash, 
[*]eliminate in-game stuttering and boost performance,
[*]added Steam Cloud support,
[*]fix cutscenes flickering,
[*]improve cutscenes’ quality (WIP)
[*]fix cutscenes audio problems.[/list]

The cutscenes may still play in lower quality, but we’re working on it.

For gamepads, you can use software of your choice, but we recommend [b]ds4drv, xboxdrv and Xpad kernel driver[/b] which we have tested and we know they work.

[h1]*[EDIT]*[/h1]
[i]"The final update has just arrived. Cutscene quality improved immensely, crashes on menus obliterated, performance boosted. Enjoy your smooth ride, Penguin Puppies!"[/i]

[b]Enjoy the game and don’t hesitate to send us love letters!
<3[/b]
[i]RUINERS[/i]

notes.title: TGIF - Linux version is now live!
notes.content:
[b]Penguins and Puppies rejoice for RUINER Linux Beta is here![/b]

Just switch to the [b]“Linux” branch[/b] and download the game. Easy! 
(Hard? Navigate to the game’s [b]Properties -> Betas[/b] and choose the relevant branch.)
We’ve hidden a cosmetic feature in the game for you, so keep looking for the tiniest easter egg ever.

There’s a sliiight chance you may experience performance issues. If you do, please install proprietary video drivers ([b]NVIDIA, Radeon[/b]) or [b]Mesa[/b]. 
In case of video-related issues, install [b]VLC 3[/b] and its dependencies. 
Also, make sure that all your drivers are proprietary and up to date.


Now, if you prefer gamepads over keyboard and mouse, you’ll need [b]ds4drv for Dualshock or xboxdrv for Xbox controllers[/b]. Get those!

It should be all sunshine and rainbows from here. But - if you encounter any bugs, crashes or anything else wrong with the game, please add a new thread on the [b]RUINER Steam[/b] forum or email us directly at support@reikongames.com (please, write [b]“[Linux]”[/b] at the beginning of the title).


And now check if you got to the [b]lucky 13[/b]!
[b]RUINER Steam keys[/b] go to:

[list][*]1. Unshra
[*]2. ♤ Evo
[*]3. YouTube.GTuxTV
[*]4. NoXPhasma
[*]5. Pray
[*]6. Big Laugh
[*]7. *Yuki*
[*]8. Wesoły Kupiec
[*]9. [ZSU] MAK777
[*]10. Baleful
[*]11. libgradev
[*]12. cbdunn46
[*]13. Max Is Back[/list]

[b]Dispatcher will add you and PM the key.[/b]

[b]Good night. Stay tight![/b]
[i]RUINERS[/i]

notes.title: Annihilation Patch is here!
notes.content:
Puppy may not speak much, but he knows his [b]Master’s voice[/b].

Thanks to our awesome community, with the [b]Annihilation Update[/b] you may play [b]RUINER[/b] in [b]Czech[/b] and [b]Ukrainian[/b]. Today’s update builds on this achievement and brings further localization fixes. Both languages have been thoroughly polished - pun intended! But if you still find anything wrong - don’t worry and keep playing!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24311777/e915bac8eddbd7f89ffc4c55501d730a9e020ce0.jpg[/img]
A big round of applause to: 

- [b]Jakub Kolarik and Jonas Kolarik for Czech localisation.[/b]

- [b]SBT Localization team: Rostyslav Sulima, Oleksii Ivanov, Oleksandr Lukianov, Olha Kmelnytska, Oleksandr Moskalenko, Yurii Bisyk, Tetiana Cherednychok, Violetta Kozakova, Sofiia Shul for Ukrainian localisation.[/b]

To those of you who couldn’t switch off [b]Halloween Mod[/b]: we removed it entirely, and now only [b]Winter Mod[/b] is included in the game so there should be no more weird conflicts.

[b]Take care,[/b]
[i]RUINERS[/i]

notes.title: The ANNIHILATION UPDATE is here!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24311777/748bdb5974d23e10595d8cb401baa66b9e7f0bd8.png[/img]
[b]Hello Puppies,[/b]

[h1]The Annihilation Update is here![/h1]

So… what does it mean? What should I think? How should I feel?
- Excited!

First of all: brand new [b]Arena: Colosseum mode[/b]. Arm up and return to Rengkok South for more adrenaline-pumping action. Face hordes of enemies in a fight to death. Finish all 10 stages to complete the [b]Colosseum[/b] challenge and bask in everlasting glory!

But that’s just the beginning.

[list][*]Your score will be recorded in the new [b]Leaderboards[/b] dedicated to the Arena: Colosseum mode. You can try and beat everyone, yourself included!

[*][b]2 new achievements[/b] await for the complete experience!

[*][b]4 new finishing moves[/b] to perform even more deadly death sentences.
 	
[*][b]2 new outfits[/b] to unlock in the Arena: Colosseum mode.[/list]

Since winter’s still here, we decided to let it snow in Rengkok. Winter Mod is here to stay. You can switch it off/on in Gameplay settings. [b]Jingle all the year![/b]

Aaand...

To our beloved console players: get your PS4s and X1s ready! Because the [b]ANNIHILATION UPDATE, bundled with the SAVAGE UPDATE and all the fixes[/b] is coming to you.
Thank you for waiting. We appreciate your patience! 

When? The ANNIHILATION UPDATE hits PC today. The consoles will get it in the next few days. Follow our social media to know as soon as it’s live on PS4 and Xbox One.

https://youtu.be/uy_zQGrmETc

[b]Best of luck and see you in one of the other dimensions,[/b]
[i]RUINERS[/i]

notes.title: Winter is coming to Rengkok!
notes.content:
[b]Welcome back Puppies[/b],

To paraphrase a famous opening line, [i]“the sky above Rengkok is the color of television, tuned to a dead channel.”[/i] But to balance the overwhelming winter cybergloom, citizens have
adorned its streets with colourful lights. 

[b]Get into the spirit and join them in the cringy celebration of wintertime![/b]

Just like the Halloween mod, [b]Winter mod is also optional[/b] - you may turn it off and on in the Main Menu - and it will be available for a limited time, until [b]4th of January 2018[/b].

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24311777/f999c8fd74d53e56cc8a1991e6e3aa2343e1328a.png[/img]
[h1]What’s new? 
Get ready for the cringe:[/h1]
[list][*]Give your enemies some sweet sugary love by beating the crap out of them with one and two-handed [b]candy canes[/b] (some of the skins are animated!).
[*]You also get to wear a [b]Santa outfit[/b], which you can choose in the Gameplay Settings. It’s optional but really ties the whole experience.
[*][b]Lootcrates[/b] have changed into presents! Kick them to get some karma.
[*]Humiliate [b]TrafficKing[/b] even more by making him wear an elf’s hat.
[*]Creeps hate this time of the year, so they turned into [b]Grinches[/b].
[*][b]It’s snowing in Rengkok[/b]. And there are some colorful lights. Really picturesque.[/list]

[b]Have fun[/b],
[i]RUINERS[/i]

notes.title: Ultra Savage Update
notes.content:
We'd like to thank our amazing community for all your feedback, it helps us improve the game!

Here's what's new:

[*][b]Beta ultrawide support[/b] is finally here! It doesn't work perfectly yet, but now you can now enjoy playing [b]RUINER in 21:9[/b]. 

[*]Feeling competitive? Have a flair for breaking games? Completing Speedrun as devs intended no longer cuts it? [b]Glitchrun[/b] may be just perfect for you! We're introducing separate leaderboards to reward players who have found glitches and exploits in the game which allow skipping arenas. We bet you cannot finish Speedrun in less than 30 minutes. Want to prove us wrong?

[*]Unlocking a jacket after NG+ didn't work correctly if the game was closed without checking out the outfit. This bug has been fixed.

notes.title: SAVAGE HOTFIX 2 is here!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24311777/0061f2f6d0f67156fcc0b22c88fa4daae281fb95.png[/img]
[b]Hey Puppies[/b],

Some of you experienced a bug with [b]NG+[/b] being disabled despite finishing the game. To fix that, you need to select Epilogue from Select Level and finish it once again. You'll probably only need to watch the last cutscene if you haven't wiped your progress by starting a New Game before. Unfortunately, we won't provide an official fix for that.

notes.title: RUINER SAVAGE UPDATE is here FREE!
notes.content:
[b]Hello Darlings[/b],

Do you sometimes dream what it would be like if all your wishes came true? Be careful what you wish for because some of them just might. Like the latest delicious [b]RUINER SAVAGE UPDATE[/b] that brings you more than you can handle. Additionally, the game is [b]33% off until November 22nd[/b]. Ready?
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24311777/4c8b446d52a8b82089820cd23e3c47081f1d2dfe.png[/img]
To those of you weirdos who can’t have enough of the misery and violence of Rengkok South: with the [b]New Game+[/b] you can stay there forever. Grab a sit, squat a block and earn your precious Karma!

If you think there’s nothing left for you to discover - you’re damn wrong! There are [b]9 cool new weapons[/b] coming in. Focus, fight and be entertained with the new, spectacular [b]Ruiner Kill[/b] finishers!

Still not enough? OK, [b]Speedrun Mode[/b] is only the first of RUINER challenges. No prologue, no dialogues, no cutscenes, no wandering about. Just pure action and the timer that won’t let you rest. Look for [b]the new guy in town[/b], he’ll tell you more. Or enter Game Modes in the main menu.

And the [b]Leaderboards[/b]? Yes, you’ll be able to track your score and brag about how awesome you are. Or keep quiet about how much tough killing is still ahead of you.

We’ve also joined forces with Rengkok’s acclaimed fashion designers who created the slickest and sickest [b]7 New RUINER Outfits[/b]! Some come free but for the really cool ones you gotta pay. With blood.

And while you’re at it, keep your ears open for the [b]two additional songs[/b] by Sidewalks and Skeletons that will make you even sadder and angrier. How fun is that!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=b4YOuLQY6JI&feature=youtu.be
And you know what the best part is? It’s... all… [b]FREE![/b] 
And that’s still not all! 

There’s ton of tweaks and fixes which will make your game even smoother. Like:
Firearms rebalance - you deal more damage overall
Overall difficulty curve tuning

[b]Out now on PC[/b]. 
Coming to [b]PS4[/b] and [b]Xone soooooon[/b]...

[b]Best of luck[/b],
[i]RUINERS[/i]

notes.title: Update #2 is already live!
notes.content:
[b]Dear Puppies[/b], 

Who doesn’t like choices? 
We know you’ve been struggling with the limitations we imposed on you, so we decided to give you freedom of choice that goes beyond [b]0[/b] and [b]1[/b] (being dead or alive). You can now assign any button from your keyboard and mouse to any action you wish. We hope you find this multitude of opportunities inspiring to discover new ways to die and survive your [b]RUINER battles*[/b]. 

But that’s not all. This new update includes many gameplay fixes, setting tweaks, some achievement progress repairs, better visuals and sounds here and there… Generally: much good stuff.

So enjoy your game and let us know how this patch changed your life for better. Or worse, if that’s your thing.

[h1]The detailed list below:[/h1]
[list][*]Added [b]keybinding[/b] for keyboard and mouse
[*]Gamepad [b]rotation sensitivity[/b] added to user settings
[*]Fixed blocker on restart after using weapon grinder on Farms
[*]Fixed [b]CATS[/b] quest achievement progress
[*][b]Power Attack[/b] now doesn’t insta-kill dashing enemies in slomo
[*][b]Skill points[/b] will no longer appear infinitely after restarting “[b]Nerve[/b]” level
[*][b]Barriers in Farm’s kill room[/b] are now lowered exactly when the timer ends regardless of skills used
[*][b]Stunning Nerve[/b] won’t make him disappear
[*][b]Ghost-Broken[/b] suicider enemies behaviour fixed
[*]Fixed [b]white screen[/b] target videos
[*]Updated information about the location of [b]secret stashes and bosses[/b]
[*]Updated [b]motorcycle scene[/b] on city loading panel
[*]Various collision, gameplay and sound tweaks
[*]Updated credits[/list]
* [i]Remember to take this freedom responsibly, though. If you suddenly start dying more quickly, remember it’s not our fault.[/i]

[b]Thanks for your patience and support[/b],
[i]RUINERS[/i]

notes.title: Ruiner tones down difficulty in first post-release update
notes.content:
If you missed last month's release of Ruiner, a stylish top-down shooter, then it's worth reading Omri's review. It's a gorgeous game, and developer Reikon has been working to make it even better by fixing the issues most commonly raised by fans, culminating in an update that tweaks the difficulty and speeds up bullet travel time to make ranged weapons more viable. 

The game has three difficulty modes: Easy, Normal and Hard. The update, launched this week, tones them all down to make the game "smoother and more accurate". Reikon says Easy mode will now allow players to explore the game's back alleys without having to worry about dying horribly. On Normal, enemies deal less damage and on both Normal and Hard they're less bullet sponge-y. 

Bullets from ranged weapons now travel faster, too, "making it easier to hit enemies" and some guns fire in a tighter spread.

If you're worried that Ruiner has lost its rock-hard appeal (as I'm sure some people will be upon reading about the changes), Reikon says you shouldn't be. "The game’s still hard, of course, especially for you, the die-hard fans! But we want to make all types of weapons, especially firearms, more viable." Fair enough.

In a smaller change (but one that Omri flagged up as a problem), stun grenades now consume 50% more energy. Previously, you could just spam them and 'stunlock' groups of enemies, including bosses. 

There's your standard bug fixes, too, all of which you can read about in the full patch notes. 

Ruiner is £14.99/$19.99 on Steam and GOG.

notes.title: Update #1 is out now!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24311777/d6a46536edb96e6c6216bf25e4ca53390341bb58.jpg[/img]
[b]Hey Puppies[/b],

Thanks to your amazing engagement and overwhelming feedback we managed to act fast and fix and patch some of the most important [b]RUINER[/b] issues. We focused our efforts on achieving even smoother and more accurate game experience.

So we’ve tuned and tweaked the normal and hard difficulty levels. Now [b]RUINER[/b] plays more evenly, and the bullets reach your enemies faster making you even more deadly. The game’s still hard, of course, especially for you, the die-hard fans!

For those of you who enjoy exploring [b]Rengkok’s[/b] back alleys more than losing yourselves in the combat, we toned down the easy difficulty level a little so you can do so with more confidence.
You can find the detailed list of tweaks below. We hope you’ll like the overall effect of tuning the beast.

Prepare for the software update. 

[b]Note[/b]: Goal of this patch are bug fixes and tuning overall gameplay experience on all difficulty levels. The game is still hard! But we want to make all types of weapons, especially firearms more viable!

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed [b]DualShock 4[/b] behaviour causing potential blockers in game
[*]Slow motion effect on weapon pickup triggers only when enemies are nearby
[*]Fixed [b]HUD[/b] disappearing after [b]TrafficKing[/b] cyborg fight
[*]Fixed enemies not spawning during one of the [b]Angel[/b] fights
[*]Fixed stun exploits on bosses
[*]It’s now possible to make the game louder than before, hopefully fixing issue with game being too quiet on some computers
[*][b]UI Tweaks[/b]
[*]Miscellaneous environment collision and gameplay fixes[/list]
[h1]GAMEPLAY BALANCE TWEEKS[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Easy[/b] difficulty made easier
[*][b]Normal[/b] and [b]Hard[/b] difficulty levels were slightly tweaked for even smoother gameplay experience, overall enemies are not bullet sponges, hero takes slightly less damage on normal
[*][b]All ranged weapons[/b] used by player have been tweaked, their projectiles are much faster making it easier to hit enemies
[*][b]Mother Unit’s[/b] laser has slower tracking, making it easier to avoid
[*][b]Stun grenades[/b] cost [b]50%[/b] more energy
[*][b]Plasma[/b] and [b]Vulcan[/b] firing spread has been narrowed
[*][b]Damage feedback[/b] has better visibility on player character
[*]Fixed [b]Nayak[/b] arena grading[/list]
[h1]STEAM[/h1][list]
[*]Added steam cards
[*]Added support for cloud saves[/list]

[b]Keybinding will be added in the next patch, very soon![/b]

[b]End of the software update[/b]...

All ranged weapons used by player have been tweaked, their projectiles are much faster making it easier to hit enemies
Mother Unit’s laser has slower tracking, making it easier to avoid
Stun grenades cost 50% more energy
Plasma and Vulcan firing spread has been narrowed
Damage feedback has better visibility on player character
